output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-generated, not demand or capacity. First-contact issues rose only 4%. Split children (240 to 3,710), customer duplicates (410 to 2,770) and the reopen rate (6% to 23%) exploded after the per-agent quota began. Agents shifted to quick-win picking, and complex tickets aged. The quota-exempt Billing-Compliance pod stayed flat on the same tooling. Staffing and hours are flat, and reopen automation is unchanged, so neither a capacity loss nor a measurement artifact explains it. Payroll is a small share. Suspend the quota and move to quality measures. Cheaply classify aged complex tickets to size any Engineering-bug contribution. Do not raise the quota or add headcount now.
